direction: TIED shares a convolution kernel across both sequence orientations and max-pools across both; FWD trains and extracts on forward input only. Both later evaluate PWM scanning on both strands. Same initialization, labels and training minibatch streams. This changes both training and extraction direction, not orientation alone.
boundary: Per filter select one activation-maximum per Discovery positive sequence, strictly above Discovery control 95th-percentile maximum activation. Require that EVERY candidate shift -2,-1,0,+1,+2 of that window fits the sequence. Use the same eligible instances for RAW shift0 and SHIFT. At least20 eligible sequences. Select a single shift per filter by greatest sum over 12 columns of PWM KL divergence against symmetric Discovery blank background; ties prefer |shift| smallest then negative shift. For negative strand, positive shift moves left in the input sequence. No reference, implanted motif or coordinates, Development/Test in choice. No independent per-instance alignment. Retain RAW/FULL and attrition logs; the interior restriction differs from the preceding pilot's original baseline.
candidate_ranking: Discovery positive-minus-blank sequence presence at each serialized PWM's Discovery blank maxscore95th percentile; ties information bits/support/id. Read saved MEME before ranking, scoring and verification to avoid prior precision mismatch. No reference or Test.
views: FULL and CAP5 all5 methods; MATCH_SHIFT for TIED_RAW/TIED_SHIFT common min(5,both candidates); MATCH_OH for TIED_SHIFT/OH48_BG common min(5,both); zero budget retained as0 F1
primary_endpoint: mut30_random MATCH_SHIFT reference-assisted full-width localizationF1 ±2bp: TIED_SHIFT minus TIED_RAW; average2 algorithm seeds within data seed before 5-data-seed summary
secondary_endpoints: CAP5 and FULL, MATCH_OH, strong and mixed-strand conditions, FWD versus TIED comparisons, classification AUROC, candidate-set false-positive rate, attrition and shift distribution; all exploratory
pilot_gate: only recommend larger independent synthetic replication if primary mean shift-vs-raw F1 delta>0, at least4/5 data seed wins, CAP5 mean delta>0, no zero matched budget, matched family blank FPR <= raw, and strong matched F1 does not worsen by more than0.05. This does not claim biological/general superiority.
statistics: 5 independent synthetic data repeats, 2 algorithm seeds averaged within each; matched differences/sign-flip two-sided 32 sign patterns as descriptive reference, n5 minimum p=.0625; no claim p<.05
test_policy: All training, PWMs, Discovery ranks, shifts and memberships locked before ANY Development or Test score. All policies fixed before fitting; later adjustments require a new Test version.
limits: synthetic known12bp contiguous motif; adjacent blank streams repeat across difficulty conditions with same seed; classification supervision on sequence labels; no true motif reference/position used in discovery; no real-data fit, SAE or finetuning
